messages:
Maya: Heads-up — bringing the Golden Scone to the office tomorrow. Ritual begins at 11:45.
Sam: wait is this a real thing now? :eyes:
Priya: 100% real. It's how we decide who gets to merge hotfixes.
Zoe: Do we have a formal eligibility rubric or is it 'who bribes the baker'? :cookie:
Maya: Official rubric: 1) karaoke courage, 2) one heroic deploy save in the past 30 days, 3) ability to fold a napkin into something resembling a crown.
Nikhil: I can do napkin crowns. Cannot promise karaoke.
Tom: Can the Golden Scone be borrowed for client demos? Asking for a demo. :trophy:
Maya: Rule 7: Golden Scone must remain on premise for at least 24 hours. No demos.
Sam: If I perform a heroic deploy save, do I get a scone AND a napkin crown, or only the scone?
Priya: Both. We don't skimp on ceremonial accessories.
Zoe: HRBot: Reminder — food brought into office must follow shared-kitchen policy. No glitter, no live animals.
Maya: Noted. Scone is gluten-containing but will provide labels. Vegan crowdfunding accepted.
Nikhil: I'll bring a tiny felt cape for the scone. Freehand sewing, hope it looks regal.
Tom: Photo ops? I vote for a silly portrait wall next to the whiteboard. Caption: "Keeper of the Golden Scone"
Priya: Promise I won't steal the scone after lunch. Maybe. :smirk:
Sam: If Priya steals it, DevOpsBot auto-rolls back to previous scone-holder commit.
Maya: Agenda: meet at 11:45, short speech (~30s), crown the scone, ceremonial sip of coffee, snack, applause.
Zoe: RSVP: +1 (will bring confetti poppers if allowed)
Nikhil: RSVP: +1 (cape and napkin crowns)
Tom: RSVP: 0 (will be remote but will judge via camera)
Priya: RSVP: +1 (offering napkin-folding lessons pre-ceremony)
Sam: RSVP: +1 (will bring camera)
HRBot: Note: please be mindful of dietary restrictions. If you need alternatives contact people-ops.
Maya: Perfect. If anyone wants to practice a 30s acceptance speech, drop your line here and we'll workshop it.
Sam: "I'd like to thank coffee, stack traces, and the person who left the last slice of pizza in the fridge."
Priya: "This scone is for everyone who believed a deploy could succeed with 2% CPU left."
Zoe: Short, emotional, ridiculous. Love it.
Maya: OK — see you all (or the camera) tomorrow. Golden Scone tradition is live. :sparkles:
